title: PJ's Pick up Military Working Dogs
description: This is a mission feature about training designed to make sure PJ's are prepared to perform rescue activities for military canines. Soundbites include Kenneth O'Brien - Pararescueman and Jack Bardsley - Military Working Dog Handler.  Produced by SSgt Shawn Bryant.  Also available in High Definition.
